facts.business: Advent Hotels International Limited is a hospitality investment holding company that owns and operates hotels through its subsidiaries and joint ventures, having been demerged from Valor Estate Limited in 2025.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital expenditure on investment property and property plant and equipment (including capital work-in-progress)

auditor.name: Mehta Chokshi & Shah LLP Chartered Accountants

key_risks: The Company is primarily an investment holding company and hospitality operations are carried out through its subsidiary companies; standalone financial statements include significant investments, loans and advances to subsidiaries, and related borrowings, whereas operating revenues and profits are substantially reflected at the subsidiary level.

Certain ratios, including ROE, ROCE, Interest Coverage Ratio and Debt Service Coverage Ratio, may not be fully representative of the underlying hospitality business and should be read in conjunction with the consolidated financial statements.
facts.related_party_note: The Company has given loans and advances to subsidiaries and has corporate guarantees extended by related parties for borrowings of joint ventures.
